text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Days were spent fine-tuning
and making adjustments for the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Yaaaahhh!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the midst of all this,
there was one thing on my mind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed as though the look in
Victoire Pisa's eyes had subtly changed.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much for today as well.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"Also, I wanted to ask,
would it be alright if I did a little voluntary training
after this?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't help staring intently at her.
It certainly didn't seem to be my imagination.
choice_data_list: ...Did you find a reason you want to run?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...You're right.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
The light from the lanterns that day was just so warm.
So, if everyone is thinking of me like that, then...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...However.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Racing is a harsh, competitive world.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
If you want to return, you can return at any time.
I do not believe things are quite that convenient.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
In any case... right now, I want to see
how far I can go in the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She might not easily return to top form.
Even so, perhaps—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Taking on the Japan Cup might just make this newly born "reason" all the more unshakable.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Holding onto such hope,
the days of devoted training began...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: *pant*, *pant*...!
choice_data_list: Just like that, stay like that...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Hk, yes!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...Mm. The drink you prepared for me
is truly delicious. What is this...?
choice_data_list: I ordered this especially because I thought you'd like the flavor.
I ordered it thinking it was a flavor you'd like.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, was that it?
Fufu, hearing that just blows all my fatigue away."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... Ngh,
10 sets left...!
choice_data_list: Keep going, everyone is waiting for you!
Keep going, everyone is waiting for you!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: (Hang on, hang on...! In order to answer that light...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"This year's Japan Cup features
an ultra-luxurious lineup!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"—From Japan, the finest umamusume of their generation
have gathered, spearheaded by Buena Vista!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Pisa-san.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I have heard the rumors.
Including the talk that the Arima Kinen will be your last...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
However,
I'm glad... that we were able to be together again.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Let's create a wonderful view once more.
Just like back then.
If it's us, I know we can do it!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
――...Yes. I'm sure I can.
After all, I've done everything within my power.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Let's deliver our run to everyone.
It's a promise...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The Japan Cup begins.
